paragraphs: (A Tanna.) He is mentioned in Chullin 55b, testifying with Yochanan ben Gurgadah that a flayed animal is unfit.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Chullin 55b writes Yochanan ben Gudgeda (גודגדא), whereas Hyman supplies Gurgadah (גורגדה). The source’s name form is retained alongside the witness difference.

The whole Davidson Chullin 55b paragraph names Elazar Safra and Yochanan ben Gudgeda testifying that a flayed animal is unfit. Hyman’s Gurgadah form and Tanna classification are retained; no additional legal discussion or historical identity is imported.
